attributes.title: [Vercel OTel] Speed Insights
attributes.description: Web Vitals performance dashboard for Vercel-hosted applications. Tracks LCP, INP, CLS, and TTFB at p75 — the Vercel benchmark percentile — over time and per page.

Web Vitals performance monitoring at the Vercel-standard p75 percentile:
- **LCP** (Largest Contentful Paint): main content load time — good < 2.5 s
- **INP** (Interaction to Next Paint): responsiveness to user input — good < 200 ms
- **CLS** (Cumulative Layout Shift): visual stability — good < 0.1
- **TTFB** (Time to First Byte): server/edge response time — good < 800 ms
- Per-page breakdowns to pinpoint regressions by route
